content.text:
All five changes are made, and typecheck, lint and the 645 unit tests pass. I haven't opened the app in a browser to look at it, and nothing is committed yet.

- **Theme:** I applied your new colours to the light app and to dark cook mode, swapped the Fraunces and Inter fonts for Manrope with the weights you gave, and updated the two hardcoded greens (the nutrition charts and the hand-tracking dots in cook mode).
- **/recipes:** a search now runs once when the page opens. Recipes where you have every ingredient move to the top, with an orange outline and a "✓ You have everything" badge. Basics the app treats as always on hand (like salt or oil) count as having them. Ingredients you have but too little of don't count.
- **/today:** the calorie and protein rings now sit side by side, with a full-width, taller "+ Log food" button below them.
- **/pantry:** the "Include empty" checkbox is gone, so items at zero are always hidden.
- **Subheaders:** I removed the descriptions under the titles on /recipes, /pantry and /status. I kept the onboarding line ("you can change all of this later") and cook mode's line explaining the buttons, arrow keys and hands-free, since those tell the user what to do rather than describe the feature. Say if you want them gone too.

Because empty items no longer show on the pantry page, its Restock button can't be reached any more. I left that code in to keep the change small.
